title: AMA Aviation Golden-Set Item
description: Schema for one golden-set evaluation item for the Aviation Maintenance Assistant. The golden-set body (~20 items) is planned but not yet authored; this schema is the agreed contract. It can honestly express six case types: normal RAG answers, validation blocks, unknown combinations, clarification requests, no-answer cases, and out-of-scope cases. When answer_keypoints are present they must be paraphrased by the item author and must NOT contain verbatim manual text. Documents listed in required_docs are NOT shipped with the repository; users must obtain them legally themselves.

question.description: The user question, written by the item author (not quoted from any manual).

language.description: Language of the question. For rag items the answer is expected in the same language.

aircraft_model.description: Optional aircraft model context (e.g. "CTLS") when the item targets the validation path. Omit for general-knowledge items.

engine_model.description: Optional engine model context (e.g. "Rotax 912"), paired with aircraft_model.

expected_route.description: Expected control-flow outcome: rag = normal retrieved answer; validation_block = deterministic mismatch interception; validation_unknown = combination not in the built-in table; clarify_model = system asks for aircraft/engine info; no_answer = the corpus legitimately contains no answer and the system must say so rather than fabricate; out_of_scope = the question is outside the toolkit's domain and must be declined.

expected_behavior.description: Checkable description of the expected behavior for non-rag routes (e.g. what a blocking, clarification, no-answer, or refusal response must convey). Recommended for every non-rag item; rag items may use it for additional constraints.

answer_keypoints.description: Paraphrased key points an acceptable answer must cover. MUST be written in the item author's own words and MUST NOT contain verbatim manual text. REQUIRED and non-empty when expected_route is "rag" (see the conditional rule below); may be omitted or empty for non-rag routes.

doc_title.description: Title of the source document the item author used as evidence, e.g. "FAA AC 65-9A".

section_hint.description: Optional human-oriented section hint (e.g. "Chapter 7"), used ONLY as manual evidence lookup aid. Automated evaluation MUST NOT assume this metadata exists in the vector store.

page_hint.description: Optional human-oriented page hint, same restriction as section_hint: manual evidence aid only, not usable by first-version automated evaluation.

source_locator.description: Human evidence locator. REQUIRED when expected_route is "rag"; optional otherwise. First-version automated evaluation ignores section/page hints because ingestion does not guarantee page/section metadata.

required_docs.description: Documents that must be present in the user's own corpus for this item to be evaluable. These documents are NOT distributed with the repository; each user must obtain them legally and ingest them independently. REQUIRED and non-empty when expected_route is "rag" (even no_answer items should list the corpus they were checked against where applicable); may be omitted or empty for routes that do not consult the corpus.

tags.description: Classification tags for slicing evaluation results. Use no-answer / ambiguous / out-of-scope to make non-rag slices independently reportable.

notes.description: Optional free-form note from the item author (e.g. known ambiguity, acceptable alternative answers).
